sonnet.problem: The story card ends on 'I will tie you up with ropes…', and the next choice card asks whether Ezekiel can roll over whenever he gets tired. The ropes make the answer obvious, so the card gives away a later answer.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.
